facts.text: The Toledo Tuition Guarantee Plan locks in undergraduate tuition rates, general fees, housing, and meal plan prices for four continuous academic years.

sources.title: Toledo Tuition Guarantee
sources.quote: The Plan provides a fixed undergraduate tuition rate and fixed-rate fees for four years.

sources.title: Toledo Tuition Guarantee
sources.quote: On-campus housing and meal plan rates also are guaranteed for four years.
